title: Past Habits & States
completion_message: ¡Perfecto! Has comprendido la diferencia sutil entre 'Used to', 'Would' y 'Be used to'. Esto hace que tus historias del pasado suenen muy naturales.

stages.title: Hábitos y Estados en el Pasado

parts.visual:
Used to vs Would: 
- 'Used to' (Solía) sirve para HÁBITOS repetidos y ESTADOS permanentes del pasado (cosas que ya no son así). 
Ej: I USED TO be the manager (Estado). 
- 'Would' (Solía) sirve SOLO para HÁBITOS repetidos (acciones). ¡NO para estados! 
Ej: Every Friday, the team WOULD go to the bar. (Acción repetida - correcto). 
Mal: I would be the manager. (Incorrecto, 'be' es un estado).
parts.audio: Used to versus Would. 'Used to' is used for repeated past habits and permanent past states that are no longer true. For example: I used to be the manager. 'Would' is used ONLY for repeated past actions or habits. NOT for states! For example: Every Friday, the team would go to the bar. That is correct. But you cannot say: I would be the manager, because being a manager is a state, not an action.

parts.visual:
Be used to vs Get used to: 
- 'Be used to' + ING / Noun: Estar acostumbrado a algo. 
Ej: I AM USED TO working under pressure. (Estoy acostumbrado a...). 
- 'Get used to' + ING / Noun: Acostumbrarse a algo (el proceso). 
Ej: I am GETTING USED TO the new software. (Me estoy acostumbrando a...).
parts.audio: Be used to versus Get used to. 'Be used to' followed by a noun or an i n g verb means to be accustomed to something. For example: I am used to working under pressure. 'Get used to' means the process of becoming accustomed to something. For example: I am getting used to the new software.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la opción correcta para hábitos y estados.

questions.question: I ____ live in London, but now I live in New York. (Solía vivir - estado).
questions.explanation: 'Live' es un estado permanente, por lo que usamos 'used to', no 'would'.

questions.question: When we were a startup, the CEO ____ buy us pizza every Friday. (Solía comprar - acción repetida).
questions.explanation: 'Buy' es una acción repetida en el pasado. Se puede usar 'would' (también 'used to', pero 'would' es muy común para historias pasadas).

questions.question: I ____ have a small office, but now I have a large one. (Solía tener - estado de posesión).
questions.explanation: 'Have' (posesión) es un estado. No se puede usar 'would'.

questions.question: It's difficult, but I am ____ waking up at 5 AM. (Estoy acostumbrado a).
questions.explanation: Be used to + ING = estar acostumbrado a.

questions.question: I can't ____ this new keyboard. It's too small. (No puedo acostumbrarme a).
questions.explanation: Get used to = el proceso de acostumbrarse.

questions.question: Before emails, people ____ send letters. (Solían enviar - acción repetida).
questions.explanation: Acción repetida en el pasado = would (o used to).

questions.question: He ____ be very shy, but now he is a great public speaker. (Solía ser - estado).
Are you ____ the cold weather here yet? (¿Estás acostumbrado a...?).
questions.explanation: Be used to + sustantivo (the cold weather).

questions.question: In the old office, we ____ have a coffee machine. (Solíamos tener - estado).
My new boss yells a lot. I'll never ____ it. (Acostumbrarme a).
questions.explanation: Get used to (proceso de adaptarse a algo nuevo).

questions.question: Every summer, my grandfather ____ take me fishing. (Solía llevarme - hábito).
questions.explanation: 'Take' es una acción, 'would' suena natural para contar recuerdos.

questions.question: I ____ commuting 2 hours a day, so 30 minutes is easy for me. (Estoy acostumbrado a).
questions.explanation: I am used to + ING (estoy acostumbrado).

questions.question: We ____ know each other, but we lost touch. (Solíamos conocernos - estado mental).
questions.explanation: 'Know' es un verbo de estado (mental), requiere 'used to'.

questions.question: I hated the new software at first, but I ____ it. (Me acostumbré - pasado de get used to).
questions.explanation: Got used to = proceso completado en el pasado.

questions.question: She ____ hate coffee, but now she drinks 3 cups a day. (Solía odiar - estado).
During the conference, the CEO ____ walk around and talk to everyone. (Solía caminar - acción).
Don't worry about the noise. I ____ it. (Estoy acostumbrado a).
Did you ____ play football when you were young? (¿Solías jugar?).
questions.explanation: En pregunta con 'Did', se usa 'use to' (sin D final).

questions.question: It took me months to ____ driving on the left. (Acostumbrarme a).
I didn't ____ like sushi, but now I love it. (No solía - estado negativo).
questions.explanation: Con 'didn't', el verbo vuelve a infinitivo: didn't use to.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa con 'used to', 'would', 'am used to' o 'get used to'.

questions.question: I ____ live here. (Solía vivir - estado)
He ____ buy us pizza. (Solía comprar - acción repetida)
I ____ have a car. (Solía tener - estado)
I ____ working late. (Estoy acostumbrado a)
I can't ____ it. (Acostumbrarme a)
Did you ____ play? (¿Solías jugar?)
I didn't ____ like him. (No solía agradarme)
She ____ be shy. (Solía ser - estado)
Are you ____ the cold? (¿Estás acostumbrado a?)
I finally ____ the new system. (Me acostumbré - pasado)

pairs.source: I used to be the boss
We would go to the bar
I am used to the pressure
I am getting used to it
I got used to the noise
Did you use to work here?

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración correcta sobre hábitos.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I used to live in London.
options: I used to live in London.
I use to live in London.
I am used to living in London.
questions.correct_answer: I used to live in London.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We would buy pizza every Friday.
options: We would buy pizza every Friday.
We used to buy pizza every Friday.
We will buy pizza every Friday.
We were used to buy pizza every Friday.
questions.correct_answer: We would buy pizza every Friday.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am used to working late.
options: I am used to working late.
I get used to working late.
questions.correct_answer: I am used to working late.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I can't get used to this keyboard.
options: I can't get used to this keyboard.
I am not used to this keyboard.
I didn't use to this keyboard.
I won't get used to this keyboard.
questions.correct_answer: I can't get used to this keyboard.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Did you use to play football?
options: Did you use to play football?
Do you use to play football?
Are you used to playing football?
Did you used to play football?
questions.correct_answer: Did you use to play football?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I didn't use to like sushi.
options: I didn't use to like sushi.
I don't use to like sushi.
I am not used to liking sushi.
questions.correct_answer: I didn't use to like sushi.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She used to be very shy.
options: She used to be very shy.
She is used to being very shy.
She gets used to being very shy.
questions.correct_answer: She used to be very shy.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Are you used to the cold weather?
options: Are you used to the cold weather?
Do you get used to the cold weather?
Did you use to the cold weather?
Are you using the cold weather?
questions.correct_answer: Are you used to the cold weather?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I got used to the noise.
options: I got used to the noise.
I am used to the noise.
I get used to the noise.
questions.correct_answer: I got used to the noise.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: He used to have a car.
options: He used to have a car.
He is used to having a car.
He gets used to having a car.
questions.correct_answer: He used to have a car.
